Negative 1 star.... Note to self... "If no one has a written review of the current version, then its best to refrain from purchasing!" I can't help but feel punked... I never complain ... but I don't want my worst enemy to fall into this trap... smh... first prob. There isn't a settings option... there are only three screens... the daily steps screen (as seen on the App Store) which the 7 day history is inaccurate... the second page option is an informational, listing step ranges from slightly inactive to moderately active... again... there are no setting options to set your personal goal... page #3 is the worst... "Tips". This page has the audacity to make suggestions on how to maximize your step count for the day (given there isn't a settings option at all... smh) And it has the nerve to charge $1.99.... I want my $1.99 back to spend it towards a worthwhile app... exhale... How could you Zachary S.. ! You promised me greatness... & I believed in you & you snatched $1.99 from me... in exchange for a joke... all I wanted was a notification once I hit my daily step goal:( uninstalled, immediately!

reviews.text: Why have an Apple Watch Widget. I downloaded this app because it advertised a widget for the Notifications center on my iPhone, and a widget for my Apple Watch. Why doesn't it read my Apple Watch for number of steps? My recommendations are to have the app read my steps from Apple Watch (or read the information from the Health App), and to send me notifications when I reach certain milestones (maybe every 10000 steps) or a step count update at certain intervals.
